武器（任意弹药），极珍稀

使用这种弹药向生命值不为满的生物发起的远程攻击检定具有优势。

Ranged attack rolls made with this ammunition have advantage against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Arrow|PHB] (@item[Bloodseeker Arrow|BMT])
  • @item[Blowgun Needle|PHB] (@item[Bloodseeker Blowgun Needle|BMT])
  • @item[Crossbow Bolt|PHB] (@item[Bloodseeker Crossbow Bolt|BMT])
  • @item[Energy Cell|DMG] (@item[Bloodseeker Energy Cell|BMT])
  • @item[Modern Bullet|DMG] (@item[Bloodseeker Modern Bullet|BMT])
  • @item[Renaissance Bullet|DMG] (@item[Bloodseeker Renaissance Bullet|BMT])
  • @item[Sling Bullet|PHB] (@item[Bloodseeker Sling Bullet|BMT])
